text: Reviews the diff against the base branch for SQL safety, LLM trust-boundary violations, conditional side effects, and other structural issues
quote: Analyzes diff against the base branch for SQL safety, LLM trust boundary violations, conditional side effects, and other structural issues.

text: Runs QA testing, then iteratively fixes bugs in source, committing each fix atomically and re-verifying
quote: Runs QA testing, then iteratively fixes bugs in source code, committing each fix atomically and re-verifying.

text: QA fixing offers three tiers: Quick (critical/high only), Standard (adds medium), and Exhaustive (adds cosmetic)
quote: Commit verified fixes atomically... Three tiers: Quick (critical/high only), Standard (+ medium), Exhaustive (+ cosmetic).

text: QA produces contract outcomes or browser health scores, fix evidence, and a ship-readiness summary, with a separate report-only mode
quote: Produces contract outcomes or browser health scores, fix evidence, and a ship-readiness summary. For report-only mode, use /qa-only.

text: Ship workflow merges the base branch, runs tests, reviews the diff, bumps VERSION, updates CHANGELOG, commits, pushes, and opens a PR
quote: Ship workflow: detect + merge base branch, run tests, review diff, bump VERSION, update CHANGELOG, commit, push, create PR.

text: Six forcing questions reframe the product before coding, push back on framing, challenge premises, and generate implementation alternatives
quote: Six forcing questions that reframe your product before you write code. Pushes back on your framing, challenges premises, generates implementation alternatives.

text: Startup mode probes demand reality, status quo, desperate specificity, narrowest wedge, observation, and future-fit
quote: Startup mode: six forcing questions that expose demand reality, status quo, desperate specificity, narrowest wedge, observation, and future-fit.

text: Auto-review pipeline runs the CEO, design, eng, and DX reviews in sequence and makes auto-decisions using 6 decision principles
quote: Auto-review pipeline — reads the full CEO, design, eng, and DX review skills from disk and runs them sequentially with auto-decisions using 6 decision principles.

text: Security review finds exploitable defects, stating attacker, boundary, impact, and challenge, with static assessment that needs no runtime or scanner
quote: Find exploitable defects. State attacker, boundary, impact, and challenge. Static assessment remains available without runtime or scanner profiles.

text: Upgrade command detects a global or vendored install, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new
quote: Detects global vs vendored install, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new.

text: Optional auto-upgrade can be enabled through the GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE setting
quote: First, check if auto-upgrade is enabled: ... GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE

text: Review, search, prune, and export what gstack has learned across sessions
quote: Review, search, prune, and export what gstack has learned across sessions.

text: Automatically reflects on failures at the end of each skill session and logs operational learnings to a per-project JSONL file
quote: gstack automatically learns from failures. At the end of every skill session, the agent reflects on what went wrong (CLI errors, wrong approaches, project quirks) and logs operational learnings to `~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl`

text: Repeated /scrape calls with the same intent run a codified script in about 200ms instead of re-driving the page
quote: Future /scrape calls with the same intent run the codified script in ~200ms instead of re-driving the page.

text: The agent saves per-site notes about websites, and future sessions on that host get those notes injected into their context
quote: Per-site notes the agent writes for itself. Compounds across sessions: once an agent figures out something non-obvious about a website, it saves a skill, and future sessions on that host get the note injected into their prompt context.

text: Promote an active per-project skill to global, cross-project scope
quote: Promote an active per-project skill to global (cross-project)

text: Supports many AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode, Copilot, and others), each defined as a typed TypeScript config
quote: Each supported AI coding agent (Claude, Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Slate, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, GBrain, Copilot, Antigravity) is defined as a typed TypeScript config

text: Adding a new agent host takes one new file and a re-export, with no changes to the generator, setup, or tooling
quote: Adding a new host means creating one file and re-exporting it. Zero code changes to the generator, setup, or tooling.

text: Compressed behavioral rules are available for agent hosts that lack a full skill install
quote: Behavioral rules from gstack (https://github.com/garrytan/gstack), compressed for agent hosts without a full skill install.

text: Works with OpenClaw's ACP runtime, adding planning discipline to the Claude Code sessions it spawns
quote: OpenClaw's ACP runtime spawns Claude Code sessions natively. gstack provides the planning discipline and methodology that makes those sessions better.

text: Uses the user's own Aside AI browser first (macOS 15+), with real cookies, logged-in accounts, and open tabs
quote: The browser it reaches for first is the user's own Aside AI browser (macOS 15+): real cookies, real logged-in accounts, the tabs they already have open.

text: Automatically falls back to a bundled persistent headless Chromium daemon driven by a compiled CLI ($B)
quote: When Aside is not installed or not running — Linux, Windows, a closed Aside app — gstack falls back, automatically, to the browser it ships itself: a persistent headless Chromium daemon behind a compiled CLI ($B).

text: Dev mode symlinks your repo into .claude/skills so Claude Code reads skills straight from your checkout
quote: That's what dev mode does. It symlinks your repo into the local `.claude/skills/` directory so Claude Code reads skills straight from your checkout.

text: A project-local setup never silently replaces a global install
quote: Project-local setup never silently replaces a global install.

text: A router sends any gstack request to the right skill: planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, or design
quote: Sends any gstack request to the right skill (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, design).

text: Voice triggers let speech-to-text aliases such as "run QA" or "test the app" invoke skills
quote: Voice triggers (speech-to-text aliases): "quality check", "test the app", "run QA".

text: Interactive plan-mode design review rates each dimension 0-10, explains what a 10 looks like, and fixes the plan
quote: Interactive plan-mode design review. Rates each dimension 0-10, explains what a 10 looks like, fixes the plan.

text: Builds a complete design system from scratch, proposes creative risks, and generates realistic product mockups
quote: Build a complete design system from scratch. Knows the landscape, proposes creative risks, generates realistic product mockups.

text: Turns vague intent into a precise, executable spec in five phases, with backlog-ready output for downstream skills
quote: Turn vague intent into a precise, executable spec in five phases. Backlog-ready output that downstream skills can pick up.

text: Systematic root-cause debugging traces data flow, tests hypotheses, forbids fixes without investigation, and stops after 3 failed fixes
quote: Systematic root-cause debugging. Iron Law: no fixes without investigation. Traces data flow, tests hypotheses, stops after 3 failed fixes.

text: Eng plan review locks in architecture, data flow, diagrams, edge cases, and tests, and surfaces hidden assumptions
quote: Lock in architecture, data flow, diagrams, edge cases, and tests. Forces hidden assumptions into the open.

text: CEO review rethinks the problem with four modes: Expansion, Selective Expansion, Hold Scope, and Reduction
quote: Rethink the problem. Find the 10-star product hiding inside the request. Four modes: Expansion, Selective Expansion, Hold Scope, Reduction.

text: Terminal-driven checks react to new output instead of waiting on a fixed polling interval
quote: Terminal-driven checks react to new output instead of waiting through a fixed polling interval.

text: Ships 23 opinionated tools acting as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
quote: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA

text: Estimates cost across model lanes for a plan (e.g. tokenmax mode with a judge), pricing every lane
quote: On the gbrain fixture plan (--mode tokenmax --judge) all seven lanes now price, for a total of $0.447.

text: Dated Claude model snapshots are priced at their alias's rate, with or without a provider prefix
quote: Dated Claude snapshots bill at their alias's price. claude-<name>-YYYYMMDD, with or without a provider prefix, resolves to the claude-<name> row.
